Russian

[edit]

Etymology 1

[edit]

с- (s-) +‎ воло́чь (volóčʹ)

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [svɐˈɫot͡ɕ]

Verb

[edit]

своло́чь • (svolóčʹ) pf (imperfective свола́кивать)

  1. to drag, to trail
  2. to draw

Etymology 2

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈsvoɫət͡ɕ]

Noun

[edit]

сво́лочь • (svóločʹ) f anim (genitive сво́лочи, nominative plural сво́лочи, genitive plural сволоче́й, relational adjective сволочно́й, augmentative сволочу́га, pejorative collective сволочьё)

  1. (derogatory, collective) riffraff, rabble
  2. asshole, scoundrel, drag
